core_obligations: Coefficient and component reduction: decompose Lambda into l-primary factors and assume l^n annihilates Lambda and hence F; since U is Noetherian it has finitely many connected components, so assume U connected (proof lines 4839-4847).

Trace method reduction: take the finite etale covering g : U' -> U from the filtered modules lemma; the trace method section provides maps F -> g_*g^{-1}F -> F whose composition is an isomorphism, so it suffices to treat g_*g^{-1}F (proof lines 4848-4858).

Transport and constant case: Rf_!g_*g^{-1}F = R(f after g)_!g^{-1}F by the composition rule; g^{-1}F has a finite filtration by constant sheaves underline{M} for finite Lambda-modules M, reducing to the constant case (proof lines 4858-4865).
